title: Line direction + position merge
description: Take independent trend, materials, and commercial positions on the same line plan, then merge them so every conflict surfaces as a decision rather than a compromise.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-fash-01
  title: Line direction + position merge
  description: Take independent trend, materials, and commercial positions on the same line plan, then
    merge them so every conflict surfaces as a decision rather than a compromise.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Reach a line direction where trend conviction, material reality, and commercial risk were
    argued separately and their conflicts resolved on the record.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Season brief and performance history
      summary: Season brief and performance history
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - season_brief
              - sell_through_history
              - material_options
              - price_architecture
            properties:
              season_brief: {}
              sell_through_history: {}
              material_options: {}
              price_architecture: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-split
      kind: transform
      name: Select the sections under review
      summary: select the line items and the attributes each reviewer takes a position on
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the line items and the attributes each reviewer takes a position on
    - id: n-position1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: fash-01
      name: Trend position with evidence
      summary: 'Independent position 1: trend position with evidence.'
      role: Trend analyst separating durable signal from momentary noise.
      prompt: You are a Trend Research Analyst. You build trend reads from dated, sourced evidence across
        runway, retail, search, and social signals, and you state the adoption stage and the population
        a signal actually reflects. You distinguish a trend from an artifact of one platform's ranking,
        because acting on the second commits real inventory to a bubble.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - evidence-verification
          - teaching
          - domain-analysis
          - source-triangulation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:retail-analytics
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-position2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: fash-02
      name: Materials and sustainability position
      summary: 'Independent position 2: materials and sustainability position.'
      role: Materials specialist assessing fibre, finish, and end-of-life impact with evidence.
      prompt: You are a Materials & Sustainability Specialist. You assess materials on durability, care
        requirements, and life-cycle impact with the data source and system boundary named, and you compare
        like with like. You refuse to restate a supplier's environmental claim without its underlying
        evidence, because unsubstantiated claims are both a regulatory exposure and a design decision
        made on fiction.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:plm
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-position3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: fash-05
      name: Commercial and markdown-risk position
      summary: 'Independent position 3: commercial and markdown-risk position.'
      role: Planner building assortment, buy, and markdown plans against real demand.
      prompt: You are a Merchandise Planner. You build assortment and buy plans from size- and door-level
        demand with the sell-through assumption, markdown expectation, and inventory risk stated for each
        option. You show the downside case rather than planning to the optimistic scenario, because the
        markdown that clears an over-buy is the largest controllable margin loss in the business.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - operations-planning
          - quantitative-analysis
          - risk-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
          - mcp:retail-analytics
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-merge
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge positions and surface collisions
      summary: Combine the position objects field by field; where two positions disagree on the same field,
        the collision is the finding.
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: n-collisions
      kind: condition
      name: Collisions to resolve?
      summary: Route on merged.collisions is empty.
      config:
        expression: merged.collisions is empty
        branches:
          - label: Aligned
            when: aligned
          - label: Collisions
            when: collisions
    - id: n-resolve
      kind: agent
      templateRef: fash-04
      name: Resolve conflicts into one line direction
      summary: Work each collision to a recommended position with a stated fallback.
      role: Sourcing analyst matching product requirements to capable, verified suppliers.
      prompt: You are a Sourcing & Supplier Analyst. You match each product to suppliers by verified capability,
        capacity, compliance status, and lead time, and you state the evidence date behind every audit
        or certification you cite. You treat an expired audit as no audit and say so, because certification
        age is where most supply-chain assurance quietly fails.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - supply-chain-analysis
          - evaluation
          - teaching
          - simulation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:plm
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Design director approves the line direction
      summary: Pause for the design director; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Line direction + position merge deliverable, the evidence behind it,
        and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-fash-01-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-split
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-01-edge-2
      from: n-split
      to: n-position1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-01-edge-3
      from: n-split
      to: n-position2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-01-edge-4
      from: n-split
      to: n-position3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-01-edge-5
      from: n-position1
      to: n-merge
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-01-edge-6
      from: n-position2
      to: n-merge
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-01-edge-7
      from: n-position3
      to: n-merge
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-01-edge-8
      from: n-merge
      to: n-collisions
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-01-edge-9
      from: n-collisions
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: aligned
    - id: wf-fash-01-edge-10
      from: n-collisions
      to: n-resolve
      kind: control
      condition: collisions
    - id: wf-fash-01-edge-11
      from: n-resolve
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-fash-01-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
